title: Services Agreement — Alpine Express Logistics
parties: BlueFin Commerce ("the Customer") and Alpine Express Logistics ("the Carrier")
service: surface parcel and light cargo, South India network

clauses.text: Freight is charged on chargeable weight, which is the higher of the consignment's actual weight and the minimum chargeable weight of 25 kg.
Rates: - consignments under 50 kg: ₹9.50 per kg of chargeable weight - consignments over 50 kg: ₹8.25 per kg of chargeable weight
All bookings travel on standard service. Express products are not offered under this agreement.
Consignments booked as fragile are handled under the Carrier's protected-handling process at ₹150.00 per consignment, in addition to freight.
In any calendar month in which the Customer tenders more than 12 consignments, the Carrier will apply a 5% discount to the invoice total for that month's invoice.
The Carrier invoices monthly. Payment is due 30 days from invoice date.
Rate revisions require 60 days' written notice and take effect from the first day of the following calendar month.
